scope: Technical acceptance-screen development, not an evaluation of a real forward trade, not source authentication or promotion.
requirements_checked: at least 12 separate fully closed forward positions in both arms
same research observation period and venue Bybit Spot
strict UTC future post-cutoff timestamp and no overlap
exclusive observed trade IDs with no unfinished positions
conservative after-cost net profit positive and not inferior to baseline
modeled intratrade low drawdown at least 20pct lower than baseline in numerical values
no historical seen 47 mixed in the input
no promotion even when arithmetic gates pass
security_and_reliability_limitations: Synthetic-only data; no actual newly closed forward positions evaluated
Caller-supplied low drawdown metric is not independently recomputed from raw OHLCV
Source claims/market prices/fills are not verified by this numeric screen
Numerical pass is necessary, never sufficient for benefit or implementation
